subject: specifying a multigroup model in which parameters are fixed in some groups and free in others

messages.author: a0ec8e0cf19a05fe
messages.subject: specifying a multigroup model in which parameters are fixed in some groups and free in others
parts:
Hello.  I am used to running multigroup models in EQS and am having some difficulties in transitioning to multigroup models in lavaan.  I have two questions:

 

1)      How can one code for a multigroup model in which a parameter is fixed in some groups and free in others?  For instance, if we have 2 groups and want the path xày to be fixed in one group but free in the other, who would one specify this?

2)      How can I specify different causal structures in different groups in a multigroup model?  More specifically, when the causal model for some groups is a subset of the causal model in other groups (i.e. some variables aren’t found in some groups)?  For instance xàyàz in one group but only yàz in another.

 

Thanks.

messages.subject: Re: specifying a multigroup model in which parameters are fixed in some groups and free in others
parts: How can one code for a multigroup model in which a parameter is fixed in some groups and free in others?  For instance, if we have 2 groups and want the path xày to be fixed in one group but free in the other, who would one specify this?

A missing value (NA) frees a parameter, and a scalar fixes a parameter.  For multiple groups, use a vector (1 element per group) instead of a single value in the syntax.

y ~ c(1, NA)*x

How can I specify different causal structures in different groups in a multigroup model?  More specifically, when the causal model for some groups is a subset of the causal model in other groups (i.e. some variables aren’t found in some groups)?  For instance xàyàz in one group but only yàz in another.

Similar to the way it is done in Mplus.  See this post:

https://groups.google.com/d/msg/lavaan/0eS49Cmgrew/bs6J52tJotAJ

Terry
